text: {"lessons":["Because past price moves do not predict future returns, I should not treat recent declines as a reason to expect a rebound or to freeze without reassessing risk.","I should base decisions on each holding’s outlook and portfolio risk, not on its average cost; selling at a loss is painful, but avoiding that pain is not a sound strategy.","Taking profits feels satisfying, but I should sell only when it fits my plan rather than simply because a position has gained."]}
